title: The car came back after twenty years 🚗
style_prompt: liminal empty office space, yellow wallpaper, damp beige carpet, buzzing fluorescent ceiling lights, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, no people, no faces, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 11:48 p.m. a car I had inspected twenty years ago pulled into my station.

scenes.narration: At 11:48 p.m. a car I had inspected twenty years ago pulled into my station.
I work nights at a vehicle inspection station. Three bays. One lamp. I log every plate.
This car was a grey hatchback. The old sticker on the windscreen had my handwriting. The expiry date said tomorrow.
The driver stayed inside. Engine off. Headlights on. He did not move.
I walked around the car. The tyres were soaking wet. The road outside was bone dry.
I opened my logbook. Same plate. Twenty years ago. And one line I did not remember writing. Inspector did not return.
I looked up. The driver's door was open. Nobody inside.
Then my lamp went out. In the dark, I heard my own pen scratching. Writing something in the logbook. Without my hand.
I switched the lamp back on. The logbook was closed. The sticker on the windscreen now said tonight's date. And my signature.
So tell me. Do you sign the sticker, or walk out?
